as_told.title: Travis Walton's return with a full beard

plain: In 1975 in Arizona, a man named Travis Walton says he was taken by aliens, and when he came back days later he had a full beard even though he had shaved just before. The researcher Mike Masters tells it this way, without giving a source. John Blitch, a scientist who worked for DARPA (the Pentagon's advanced research agency) and says he was abducted himself, mentions Walton coming back five days later. Michels gives the gap as four days in one episode, and in another simply calls Walton's beard an example of a common thread in abduction stories. If true, it would suggest much more time passed for Walton than for the people around him.
